subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young woman in <Picture 1>, with fair skin, glossy red lips, black hair gathered into a high messy bun with loose face-framing tendrils, a fine gold chain with a small pendant, a pale pink ribbed long-sleeve cardigan worn open over a white lace-trimmed camisole.

summary:
[reference generation] A 15-second K-pop style singing-and-dancing music video set on a Korean idol MV stage. <Subject 1> performs choreography and lip-syncs to the track under neon stage lights; <Picture 1> provides her facial features, high bun, tendrils, necklace, pink cardigan, and white lace camisole as the appearance reference.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - her facial features, high messy bun, loose tendrils, pendant necklace, pale pink ribbed cardigan, and white lace-trimmed camisole stay consistent across every shot.
<Picture 1>: partially_preserved - the face, hairstyle, accessories, and costume are retained, while the plain pink studio backdrop is replaced by a Korean-style neon MV stage with haze and moving spotlights.

detailed_description:
The target video is a glossy Korean idol-style singing-and-dancing MV: a dark studio stage filled with thin haze, neon pink and electric-blue light strips, moving spotlights, a geometric LED wall, and quick rhythmic cuts between camera angles, with a saturated pink-magenta color grade and a crisp dance-pop beat.
[Shot 1] The video opens on a medium full shot of <Subject 1> standing center stage inside a Korean-style MV set: a dark backdrop wall of glowing neon pink vertical strips with faint blue edge light, soft haze drifting across the floor, and a few round spotlights beaming down from above. She faces the camera with a confident smile, shoulders relaxed, and begins the opening choreography: both arms rise in a controlled wave above her head, her hips sway side to side on the beat, and her weight shifts from one foot to the other. Her lips move naturally in sync with the melody as she performs, chest up, gaze locked on the camera. The camera slowly dollies in from full-body to a medium shot, keeping her centered, while a pink key light lights her face and a thin rim light from the rear separates her bun from the glowing strips behind her.
[Shot 2] At 00:05.000, the shot cuts to a medium side-angle shot as <Subject 1> steps into the main dance phrase. The stage lights shift: a moving blue spotlight sweeps across the haze and a row of LED blocks on the floor pulses pink on each beat. She performs a sharp arm sweep across her body, turns her upper body toward the left, then snaps back to face forward, knees soft and bouncing on each beat. Her loose tendrils swing with the movement, the open cardigan sways with her turns, and she keeps lip-syncing with an energetic, playful expression, raising one hand to point toward the camera on the downbeat. The camera tracks laterally with her at waist height, and the pendant on her necklace catches a brief flash of side light.
[Shot 3] At 00:10.000, the shot cuts to a close-up framed from the chest up. The neon strips behind her blur into pink and blue bokeh through the haze. <Subject 1> leans slightly forward, eyes bright, and finishes the final vocal phrase with her lips moving in sync, then raises one hand in a small finishing gesture and tilts her head with a bright smile. She holds the final pose for the last two beats, the bun and tendrils settling, while the camera pushes in a little more and the spotlights glow softly around her. The video ends on her smiling, looking into the lens.

overall_soundscape:
Quiet stage room tone underneath the track, with faint shoe taps on the smooth stage floor, soft fabric rustle from the cardigan during turns, and light controlled breathing between phrases.

non_diegetic_music:
An upbeat K-pop dance-pop track at around 120 BPM, four-on-the-floor kick drum, bright synth pluck melody, warm bass line, layered handclaps on the off-beats, and a short vocal chop hook, building slightly into the final phrase and ending cleanly on the last beat.
